WITH sma_10005_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , member_id AS member
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' then 1 else 0 end AS __paid_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end AS __valid_order_count
    , case when status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end AS __cancelled_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end AS __refund_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 and refund_cents < paid_cents then 1 else 0 end AS __partial_refund_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents > 0 and refund_cents = paid_cents then 1 else 0 end AS __full_refund_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end AS __payment_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end AS __refund_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end AS __net_sales_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end AS __gross_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end AS __discount_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end AS __buyer_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then member_id end AS __refund_buyer_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then store_id end AS __selling_store_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end AS __valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" order_semantic_src_10000
)

, sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    member_id AS member
    , tier
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_semantic_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_26.member__tier, subq_35.member__tier) AS member__tier
  , MAX(subq_26.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.payment_cents) AS payment_cents
  , MAX(subq_26.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  , MAX(subq_26.net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_26.gross_cents) AS gross_cents
  , MAX(subq_26.discount_cents) AS discount_cents
  , MAX(subq_26.buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_26.refund_buyer_count) AS refund_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_26.selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
  , MAX(subq_26.valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  , MAX(CAST(subq_35.net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_35.valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_order_value
  , MAX(CAST(subq_35.net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_35.buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_buyer_value
  , MAX(CAST(subq_35.valid_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_35.buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS purchase_frequency
  , MAX(CAST(subq_35.refund_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_35.payment_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS refund_amount_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_35.cancelled_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_35.order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS cancel_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_35.refund_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_35.paid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS refund_order_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_35.discount_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_35.gross_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS discount_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_35.valid_order_items AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_35.valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    sma_10001_cte.tier AS member__tier
    , SUM(subq_18.__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(subq_18.__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(subq_18.__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(subq_18.__gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(subq_18.__discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_18.__buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_18.__refund_buyer_count) AS refund_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_18.__selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
    , SUM(subq_18.__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      member
      , __order_count
      , __paid_order_count
      , __valid_order_count
      , __cancelled_order_count
      , __refund_order_count
      , __partial_refund_order_count
      , __full_refund_order_count
      , __payment_cents
      , __refund_cents
      , __net_sales_cents
      , __gross_cents
      , __discount_cents
      , __buyer_count
      , __refund_buyer_count
      , __selling_store_count
      , __valid_order_items
    FROM sma_10005_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_18
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    sma_10001_cte
  ON
    subq_18.member = sma_10001_cte.member
  GROUP BY
    sma_10001_cte.tier
) subq_26
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    sma_10001_cte.tier AS member__tier
    , SUM(subq_28.__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(subq_28.__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_28.__buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , SUM(subq_28.__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(subq_28.__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(subq_28.__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(subq_28.__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(subq_28.__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(subq_28.__paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(subq_28.__discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , SUM(subq_28.__gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(subq_28.__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      member
      , __order_count
      , __paid_order_count
      , __valid_order_count
      , __cancelled_order_count
      , __refund_order_count
      , __payment_cents
      , __refund_cents
      , __net_sales_cents
      , __gross_cents
      , __discount_cents
      , __buyer_count
      , __valid_order_items
    FROM sma_10005_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_28
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    sma_10001_cte
  ON
    subq_28.member = sma_10001_cte.member
  GROUP BY
    sma_10001_cte.tier
) subq_35
ON
  subq_26.member__tier = subq_35.member__tier
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_26.member__tier, subq_35.member__tier)
